question: What Docs updates came out on May 22nd, 2024?
ground_truth:
The 2024-05-22 release introduced the following changes:
- Advanced Redirects: Implemented a powerful redirects system supporting pattern matching and parameter preservation.
- API Authorization Handling: Enhanced API authorization handling in the documentation platform.

metadata.cited_context:
## Advanced Redirects
Implemented a powerful redirects system supporting pattern matching and parameter preservation. Teams can now manage documentation URL structure while maintaining backwards compatibility.

```yaml
redirects:
  - source: /v1/api/*
    destination: /v2/api/:splat
    permanent: true
  - source: /guides/:name
    destination: /tutorials/:name
```

## API Authorization Handling
Enhanced API authorization handling in the documentation platform. Developers can now test authenticated endpoints more easily with improved token management.
